result.reason: The added clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy limits and certificates on request, but omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law, so it does not reach either the preferred or fallback position. It also unnecessarily requires all coverage to continue for one year after termination, which is not required by the playbook and is not tailored to claims-made policies. The original entire-agreement provision is otherwise preserved, and the operative language is generally professional, though “Sparkling’s data” should track the defined term “Customer Data.”
